summary: Implemented `in` membership in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns False for non-URIRef and otherwise checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Also changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to dir(self.uri). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering prefix membership (positive, proper-prefix negative, self, SH), RDFS closed membership (label positive, undefined term negative, plain string and Literal negatives), and RDF closed membership (type positive, rdf:_1 negative). Tests and doctests were not run, per instructions. Nothing committed.
